openalex.title: A comparative proteomics resource: proteins of Arabidopsis thaliana
openalex.abstract: Using an integrative genome annotation pipeline (iGAP) for proteome-wide protein structure and functional domain assignment, we analyzed all the proteins of Arabidopsis thaliana. Three-dimensional structures at the level of the domain are assigned by fold recognition and threading based on a novel fold library that extends common domain classifications. iGAP is being applied to proteins from all available proteomes as part of a comparative proteomics resource. The database is accessible from the web.
